notes: Sample entry — shows the schema. Delete once you have real designs.
recreation_prompt: Build a full-viewport hero section with a near-black (#050505) background and an animated aurora-style gradient mesh (blurred, softly moving blobs of #7c5cff and #00e0c6 at ~40% opacity, generated with layered radial-gradient divs or an SVG filter, animated via CSS keyframes drifting position over 20s+ ease-in-out loops). Centered headline in a large bold sans-serif, subheading below in a muted gray, and a single pill-shaped CTA button with a subtle glow on hover. On scroll, fade and slightly translate the hero content upward using an IntersectionObserver-driven class toggle (opacity 1→0, translateY 0→-20px), so it feels like the hero dissolves as you scroll past it.

title: Notosan — auto-advancing nature hero carousel
notes: Flat-illustration travel site hero ("Notosan" — Noto Nature Park). A 10s looping full-bleed carousel auto-cycles through 3 scenes, each with its own heading, copy, and character illustration, joined by a quick wipe/crossfade transition.
recreation_prompt:
Build a full-viewport (100vh) hero section for a fictional travel brand called "Notosan" that auto-advances through 3 flat-illustration nature scenes on an infinite loop, styled like a Studio-Ghibli-esque promotional site for a Japanese nature park.

LAYOUT (shared across all 3 scenes):
- Fixed/sticky top nav bar, transparent over the illustration: logo wordmark "Notosan" top-left in white, centered/right-aligned nav links "Community · About · Support · Contact", and a pill-shaped outlined "Register" button (1px white border, transparent fill, white text) at the far right.
- Small uppercase "kicker" label sits above the main heading (e.g. "05 Experience", "05 Habitat") in a small, letter-spaced, semi-transparent white font — changes per scene.
- Large display heading below the kicker in a bold serif or high-contrast sans (~72–96px), pure white, left-aligned, positioned in the lower-left half of the viewport (e.g. "VISITE", "Tranquility", "Biodiversity").
- Below the heading: 2–3 lines of body copy (~14px, ~60% white opacity, max-width ~420px) giving flavor text about Noto Nature Park's biodiversity/tranquility/scenery.
- A CTA below the copy: either a filled white pill button with dark text + right-chevron icon ("Start the journey →") on the first scene, or a plain underlined text link with a small arrow ("— Learn more") on the other two scenes.
- A large flat-vector character illustration (a traveling pilgrim/fisherman figure in a wide straw hat and layered robes, carrying a walking staff/fishing rod) anchored bottom-right, roughly 30–40% of viewport width, reused across scenes with slightly different poses.
- Foreground silhouette elements (tall grass blades, rocks, plants) along the bottom edge in near-black, layered in front of the background art for depth.

THE 3 SCENES (each holds for ~3.3s of the 10s loop):
1. "VISITE" — warm dusty-purple dusk sky (#3a3366 → #946570 → #ffd2cc gradient) behind a large glowing mountain range lit gold/orange at the peak, a flock of small birds silhouetted mid-flight crossing the mountain, calm lake at the base reflecting the sky, character stands in tall grass gazing at the mountain. CTA: filled white pill "Start the journey".
2. "Tranquility" — cool indigo-navy scene (#181a3d/#0e1339) of a tall waterfall cascading down dark rock formations into a pool, soft diagonal god-ray light beams crossing the falls, small bats/birds gliding low across the bottom of the frame, character now seated fishing at the water's edge. CTA: "— Learn more" text link.
3. "Biodiversity" — same indigo-navy waterfall environment as scene 2 but pulled back to reveal a spotted deer grazing among rocks and glowing bioluminescent-looking teal/orange plants in the foreground; heading and nav persist top-left. CTA: "— Learn more" text link.

TRANSITION: Scenes cut over quickly (well under a second) with a soft vertical wipe/curtain reveal — the incoming scene sweeps in (direction: bottom-to-top reveal, i.e. the new scene's art uncovers the old one from the bottom edge upward) with a light crossfade blending the two illustrations' colors at the seam for a couple of frames, rather than a hard cut or a slow multi-second dissolve. After scene 3, it wipes straight back into scene 1 to loop seamlessly.

IMPLEMENTATION APPROACH: Use 3 absolutely-positioned full-bleed `<section>` layers stacked in the hero container, each with its own background illustration (SVG or layered PNG/CSS shapes), heading/copy/CTA. Drive an active-index state with `setInterval` (~3300ms), toggling a `.active` class. On change, animate the incoming section with a `clip-path: inset(0 0 0% 0)` → animate the inset's bottom value from 100% to 0% over ~500ms with an ease-out curve (this produces the bottom-to-top wipe), while cross-fading opacity 0→1 over the same duration; the outgoing section simply stays in place beneath (no exit animation needed since the incoming wipe fully covers it). Add subtle idle motion within each scene: birds/bats drifting slowly via CSS `translateX` keyframe loops, and a slow ~20s ambient parallax drift (translateY 2–4px) on the background art layer for a living, non-static feel. Nav bar and Register button are shared, outside the scene stack, and stay fixed throughout — only the kicker/heading/copy/CTA/illustration swap per scene.

COLOR PALETTE (sampled from the source): background darks #0e1339 / #181a3d, mid purples #3a3366 / #7a6995 / #7d76b1, warm accents #946570 / #bb9b8d / #ffd2cc. Typography is white/off-white at full and reduced opacity throughout — no other UI chrome or color is used.
